manipulation: Add explicit 1-based source line numbers to a matched row display. Each display row contains one JSON-encoded original source line including its ending. All source packets, protocol text, and display instructions are unchanged between arms.
limits: Two short author-labeled review cases, two field orders, three repeats per presentation; counts are not general error rates.
Both arms use a new row display. The plain arm is a concurrent control, not byte-identical to the earlier escaped-packet prompt.
Numbering adds tokens and changes presentation; this tests the usefulness of supplying line numbers, not a terminal-wrapping cause.
Case order rotates; presentation order alternates. The schedule is fixed, not randomized. Fresh sessions do not establish statistical independence.
Temperature and immutable provider model version are not pinned; compare recorded model and CLI identity.
Authority quote omission is separate from successful location. Exact quote resolution does not establish semantic support.
Labels are inherited, not independently calibrated. This does not supply a calibrated release pass.
